goal.title: 2 · Numbers land in =
goal.text:
a b * puts the product into the name =, and clears the line. =~ looks the name up and puts its value back on the line.

Print 42, starting from 6 and 7.

steps.text: Type 6, Enter, 7, Enter: two numbers on the line.
Type * and Enter. The product goes into the name =, and the line is cleared.
Type =~ to put the value of = back on the line, then > to print it.
